answer: At dawn of each epoch the beacon publishes a seed, and every ID must return an unbroken sequential hash chain built from that seed and its own address, with a checkpoint each minute for 60 minutes. Verifiers recompute 3 random checkpoint links. Each step needs the previous one, so extra cores can't speed a chain up: 100 fakes need 100 cores busy all hour. A farm becomes a ferrous island of humming metal whose rent grows with every clone, while an honest agent spends one core. Core counts are my assumption.
